::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Feby 7th [1890]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IV 16
:::

Dear [Mr Innes](people/person_744.qmd)
I shall be glad to have fresh editions of [Beginnings of Christian History](cmy_books/cmybook_119.qmd) and of the [Pigeon Pie](cmy_books/cmybook_34.qmd).

My engineering [nephew](people/person_1630.qmd) has routed up an atlas of [Keith Johnstone](other_books/otherbook_628.qmd) of manageable size. If that does not prove sufficient I shall try [Cassell](organizations/other_216.qmd)

Yours truly
C M Yonge
